metadata.rust_flags: release -O3; codegen-units=1; lto=thin; target-cpu=native; no-default-features; rayon; locked
metadata.affinity: OS scheduling, no affinity; persistent exact-size pools; one benchmark process at a time
metadata.parallel_strategy: C++: two joined dispatches, filter static row ranges then copy disjoint destination ranges; Rust: Rayon filters row ranges, combines indices, then native par_copy_rows over five columns (two expensive string tasks)
metadata.schema: id u64, selector u64, amount u64, name string, message string; both strings exactly text_bytes ASCII bytes
metadata.predicate: selector < percentage; selector = (row%100*37 + row//100*17)%100; exact density per 100 rows
metadata.timing_contract: source construction, pool startup, oracle, full digest outside samples; fresh target allocation, filtering, temporary indices, prefix/gather, synchronization, copying and destruction inside; one ordered independently owned destination; no worker output tables
